name: xion-local-memory-inference-p1b6-large-batch-review-authority-amendment-v1

decision.statement: The intended large-batch workflow is not exhaustive manual HUMAN labeling of roughly 300 newly authored surfaces. The canonical design had generalized the small batch-001/batch-002 HUMAN-review workflow into blanket requirements; those requirements are superseded prospectively for large-batch growth.

supersededProspectiveClauses: every final item requires primary blind HUMAN review
HUMAN gold is authoritative for every surface
every eligible HELD candidate requires repeated HUMAN review

historicalAuthority.note: Batch-001 and batch-002 HUMAN review, re-review and acceptance receipts keep their original authority and wording. This amendment neither reopens nor renames any historical HUMAN decision.

steps: the effective-current semantic skeleton catalog defines the intended reference label
a fresh separate strong model performs blind semantic realization review
agreement between the blind strong-model decision and the reference label validates the realization provisionally
HUMAN review is reserved for strong-model/reference disagreement, FIX, REJECT, and a small deterministic calibration sample

labelProvenanceCategories.HISTORICAL_HUMAN_CONFIRMED: Carried from batch-001/batch-002 HUMAN review and acceptance. Unchanged by this amendment.
labelProvenanceCategories.CATALOG_STRONG_MODEL_CONFIRMED: Source audit PASS, blind strong-model KEEP, and a strong-model decision equal to the effective-current reference label. Provisionally eligible. NOT HUMAN gold.
labelProvenanceCategories.HUMAN_ADJUDICATED: The repository owner actually reviewed the row and adjudicated it.

humanProvenanceClaim.note: No item may be described as HUMAN-reviewed unless the repository owner actually reviewed it. A clean calibration sample is QA evidence about the pipeline; it does not make unreviewed rows human-confirmed.

humanAdjudicationSemantics.KEEP_matching_reference: May make the row eligible as HUMAN_ADJUDICATED.
humanAdjudicationSemantics.KEEP_opposing_reference: Must not silently override the catalog. Treat the current realization as a semantic mismatch requiring surface repair or rejection; repeated same-skeleton mismatch may trigger an explicit skeleton-realizability review.

finalHeldOutContract.humanAdjudicationScope: HELD rows with a second-review disagreement, FIX or REJECT only
